raw_segments.text: Upon my word, Luzhin cried wrathfully and irritably, crimson with confusion, to distort
Excuse me, allow me to assure you that the report which has reached you, or rather, let
me say, has been conveyed to you, has no foundation in truth, and I—suspect who?
She seemed to me in other things, with all her excellent qualities, of a somewhat high-flown
But I was a thousand miles from supposing that she would misunderstand and misrepresent
things in so fanciful a way.
